purpose: Attention difference-scan probe with cache reuse, bounded multi-ROI refresh, fixed ROI workers, deterministic merge, and stale-result rejection.
expected_effect: Run a low-resolution full-frame difference scan on every frame and reuse the contour cache when no material change is detected.
Process independent dirty ROIs through a fixed worker pool and merge results in ROI index order on the main refresh path.
Reject cache-version or age-stale async results and synchronously fall back when alignment or dirty-area gates fail.
risk: The first implementation only gates small 2D translation; it does not reproject cached contours for camera rotation or depth parallax.
Color-contour extraction is parallelized, but downstream depth clustering and final pixel assignment still run full-frame.
OpenCV kernels may use internal threads, so four ROI workers can oversubscribe some CPUs.
